finding: No pending tracked Markdown file deletions found; substantial removed/replaced sections in existing docs reviewed and preserved. Untracked files deleted before this review cannot be reconstructed from Git.

article_useful_topics.finding: Historical ASAP7 model compatibility and unavailable physical verification decks explain the exploration of other PDKs. Earlier MOSCAP retention failures are prototype-specific; final layout uses GF180MCU.
article_useful_topics.source: HEAD:docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, ASAP7 analog readiness and Model-to-circuit contract sections
article_useful_topics.scope: Historical tool/model evidence; not a current foundry comparison or a final GF180 result.

article_useful_topics.finding: Storage scales with spatial state count, not the 140k weight count. An older 7x7 micrometre plate extrapolation gave 1517.824 mm2 for 30,976,000 membrane plates alone; access circuitry, adaptation and routing are additional.
article_useful_topics.scope: Historical capacitor geometry extrapolation, not the final 5x5 MIM design or delivered GDS die area.

article_useful_topics.finding: Selected-frame float software replays showed strong degradation with independent state noise; scaling and companding changed sensitivity. Training dtype or Q7.16 export does not establish analog precision.
article_useful_topics.source: HEAD:docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Linear state-noise tolerance screen; HEAD:docs/RESULTS.md
article_useful_topics.scope: Software sensitivity experiments on selected records, not physical sampled-noise measurements or full validation mIoU.

article_useful_topics.finding: Tracking parking, autozero and shared feedback/readout circuitry were explored to control source-switching charge and avoid per-neuron replication of expensive analog service circuitry. Local state-dependent variation must not be described as total weight accuracy.
article_useful_topics.source: HEAD:docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Tracking parking and Leading alternative sections
article_useful_topics.scope: Historical circuit diagnostics; final module evidence and operating boundaries take precedence.

article_useful_topics.finding: Presynaptic events trigger signed contributions; weights control contribution magnitude, not source firing frequency. Accumulate within the model bin, apply learned beta once, and preserve subtractive reset, adaptation and inhibition ordering. Final class readout accumulates current rather than allocating class PLIF neurons.
article_useful_topics.scope: Use original epoch58 float semantics. Early quantized ranges and provisional ASAP7 voltage scales are obsolete for the final implementation.
